keep: Clean crisp frames that show only this creature; the transparent background stays empty. Colors, brightness, material finish and lighting stay exactly as in the still in every frame. Existing colored markings remain steady and the same size. The creature keeps its original body proportions and full silhouette inside the canvas. Keep exactly four paws, one feline head, one curled tail, the same attached crescent plates, joint markings and hollow chest. All stars, chest details and silver-gold plates stay identical in color and brightness.

clips.idle: Gentle feline breathing: shoulders rise subtly and the curled tail shifts slightly while all four paws remain planted.
clips.walk: Walks in place on four paws in a smooth stalking gait with the original tail curl.
clips.attack: Raises one front paw slightly, pushes it forward in one controlled strike in the first half, then plants it back in its original pose.
clips.hurt: Flinches at the shoulders and dips its head briefly, then returns to its stance.
clips.death: Four legs buckle, body lowers onto its side and head settles down, ending lying still with tail and plates attached.
